quests.name: Bulging Muscles: The First Trial
quests.offer: You think you are strong? We shall see. My beasts roam the Old Man's hill in the gloomy valley of Bandit Hills, east of Jared's Blight. Walk its eastern slope, and bring me two of their tails.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are.
quests.started: Go, and do not come back without the tails.

steps.journal: Walk the eastern slope of the Old Man's hill in Bandit Hills (E).

events.text: You are ready for the first trial of Goran! Two of his beasts come at you.

steps.journal: Kill Goran's beasts on the hill and take two beast tails.
Bring the two beast tails to Goran the Strong in Halas.
steps.says: Two tails! Not bad. When you are ready, the Old Man has a harder trial for you.

quests.name: Bulging Muscles: The Second Trial
quests.offer: Your second trial. Find the Old Man on the right-hand hill of that valley in Bandit Hills and speak with him. Three of my beasts will answer. Bring me their furs.
quests.accept: I can take anything you throw at me.

steps.journal: Speak with the Old Man on the hill in Bandit Hills (E).
steps.says: Goran sent another one, did he? Then face his beasts.

steps.journal: Kill the three beasts the Old Man calls and take their furs.
Bring the three beast furs to Goran the Strong in Halas.
steps.says: Three furs. You are stronger than you look. One more trial before the last.

quests.name: Bulging Muscles: The Third Trial
quests.offer: The third trial is harder. Malisarisent, a little gnome woman, waits on the other hill of the valley in Bandit Hills. Speak with her and four of my beasts will come. Bring me four of their claws.

steps.journal: Speak with Malisarisent on the valley's other hill, Bandit Hills (E).
steps.says: Oh dear, Goran's beasts again. Here they come!

steps.journal: Kill the four beasts Malisarisent calls and take their claws.
Bring the four beast claws to Goran the Strong in Halas.
steps.says: Four claws. Now only my pet stands between you and the last of my strength.

quests.name: Bulging Muscles: The Final Trial
quests.offer: My pet lives in the serpent cave in Bandit Hills. Speak with Lairt'tsal outside it, fight your way past my beasts down the right-hand fork, and bring me my pet's eye. Then you will know true strength.
quests.accept: Cave, Bandit Hill, I got it.
quests.started: Go. My pet does not like visitors.

steps.journal: Speak with Lairt'tsal outside the serpent cave in Bandit Hills (E).
steps.says: The last trial. Goran's pet is awake now. Take the right-hand fork.

steps.journal: Kill Goran's pet down the right-hand fork of the serpent cave.
Bring the eye of Goran's pet to Goran the Strong in Halas.
steps.says: My pet's eye! You are as strong as I am. There is nothing more I can teach you.

quests.offer: Stamina is not strength. It is standing when others fall. My brother Bearcis waits on the hill to the south. Ask him for the first wave, outlast it, and bring me the mark its leader carries.
quests.declined: Then rest. The waves will wait.
quests.started: Go to Bearcis. Do not fall.

steps.journal: Ask Bearcis, on the hill south of Faercis, for the first wave.
steps.says: Then stand your ground. Here they come!

steps.journal: Outlast the first wave: kill the three that come at you.
Kill the leader of the first wave and take its mark.
Bring the mark of the first wave to Faercis by the pond.
steps.says: Still standing. Good. My brother has more for you.

quests.name: Unrivaled Grace: The First Trial
quests.offer: Grace is not given, it is learned in a fight. Find the halfling Baloren in the tavern north of the coachman. He will put you on the road to Leumas Si Taerg, who sets the first trial. Bring 5000 tunar.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find the halfling Baloren on the first floor of the tavern north of Freeport's coachman.
steps.says: Medaesis sent you? Then go upstairs and see Aldan Vas. He will want paying.

steps.journal: Pay Aldan Vas, upstairs in the tavern, 500 tunar.
steps.says: Leumas Si Taerg is upstairs in the tavern in Strag's Rest, just off the road. Tell him I sent you.

steps.journal: Find Leumas Si Taerg upstairs in the tavern of Strag's Rest (SE).
steps.says: North along the mountain, past the T stone, are three orange tents. Speak to the gnoll there.

steps.journal: Speak to the gnoll among three orange tents north of Strag's Rest.
steps.says: One, two, three, but not as you count them. Fight!

steps.journal: Kill the gnoll called eno (one of three, in order) at the tents.
Kill the gnoll called owt (two of three, in order) at the tents.
Kill the gnoll called eerht (three of three, in order) at the tents.
Kill the reaver leader and take his sword.
Bring the leader's sword and 4500 tunar to Leumas Si Taerg in Strag's Rest.
steps.says: The first trial is passed. Medaesis will have more for you.

The guide's Patron who calls Leumas when he is not up is left out (he stands there). The gnolls' places are EQOA-Data's map points.

quests.offer: The second trial is in Serpent Hills, to the north. Find the gnoll there and win his fight as you won the first. Bring me what the leader carries.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Speak to the gnoll in Serpent Hills (N).
steps.says: Uno, dos, tres. Backwards! Fight!

steps.journal: Kill the gnoll called onu (one of three, in order) in Serpent Hills.
Kill the gnoll called sod (two of three, in order) in Serpent Hills.
Kill the gnoll called sert (three of three, in order) in Serpent Hills.
Kill the reaver leader and take his sword.
Bring the leader's sword to Medaesis outside Freeport's north gate.
steps.says: Faster than the first time. Good.

quests.offer: The third trial changes the rules. Go to Fort Alliance, near the Razgut camp, and speak to the gnoll by the rock near the barracks. Kill six of the reavers he sets on you.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Speak to the gnoll by a rock near the barracks in Fort Alliance (E).
steps.says: New rules. Six reavers, and quickly!

steps.journal: Kill six Razgut reavers.
Return to Medaesis outside Freeport's north gate.
steps.says: Six! You are quick. One trial left.

quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.says: Medaesis's student? The gnoll by the dam in Stone Watchers waits for you.

steps.journal: Speak to the gnoll by the dam in Stone Watchers (C).
steps.says: First, second, third. Backwards!

steps.journal: Kill the gnoll called tsrif (one of three, in order) by the dam.
Kill the gnoll called dnoces (two of three, in order) by the dam.
Kill the gnoll called driht (three of three, in order) by the dam.
Return to Psahn in Highpass.
steps.says: Done? Then Medaesis will want to know.

steps.journal: Return to Medaesis outside Freeport's north gate.
steps.says: You move like water now. There is nothing more I can teach you.

quests.name: Sage's Wit: The First Cases
quests.offer: Wisdom is judging rightly. Two cases wait. Nanie Gubbins or Debo Diblin poisoned a pie in Bobble-by-Water; Gregor Pyrely or Snidely Infernis wronged the other in Highbourne. Find the guilty and bring me proof.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Nanie Gubbins by the first big tree up the river from Bobble-by-Water's coachman.
steps.says: A pie? I know nothing of a pie! How dare you! You will never prove it!

steps.journal: Defeat Nanie Gubbins and take her gown.
Find Gregor Pyrely by the first big tree north along Highbourne's dockside.
steps.says: Snidely told you that? Then you know too much!

steps.journal: Defeat Gregor Pyrely and take his spellbook.
Bring the gown and the spellbook to Judicial Advisor Lot on Hazinak's eastern wall.
steps.says: Rightly judged, both. Two harder cases wait when you are ready.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/stat-boost-quests.json, # Wisdom CM Statistic Boost, Quest #1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's reward is the next rank of the Sages Wit mastery line opening for purchase (cmcatalog 'Sages Wit 1'); this server sells those ranks with no quest, and a quest step has no way to open one, so the trial gives no reward here (an open question for the engine). Nanie Gibbons and Debo Bibin in the guide are the live game's Nanie Gubbins and Debo Diblin (FrontiersForge's names; both spellings stand in Bobble-by-Water). The guide's 5000-tunar reset for a wrong judgment is left out: the innocent are not part of the quest. A guilty party who turns on you is a talker the step's start spawns hostile (a copy, attackable); check_quests.py wants an attackable row of the name, so Nanie Gubbins is listed as unresolved until one exists (a seed's ATTACKABLE entry) or the checker accepts a hostile spawn.

quests.name: Sage's Wit: The Second Cases
quests.offer: Two more cases. Znib Crankshaft and Gnolan Boltratchet, ant farmers, accuse each other in the Ant Colonies. And Rizik Flangletoggle is missing: his brother Nizen blames the troll Ugmar Malgus. Judge them both.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Gnolan Boltratchet by a boulder at the black ant guard hill, Ant Colonies (S).
steps.says: Branded his ants? Prove it! Guards!

steps.journal: Defeat Gnolan Boltratchet and take his ant brander.
Find Nizen Flangletoggle on a small hill north of Neriak's coach, near the firebat valley.
steps.says: The troll ate him, everyone knows that! Why are you looking at me like that?
steps.answer: You did away with your own brother.

steps.journal: Defeat Nizen Flangletoggle and take the cog he carries.
Bring the ant brander and the cog to Judicial Advisor Lot in Hazinak.
steps.says: The troll is cleared, and the brother answers for it. Well judged.

quests.name: Sage's Wit: The Third Cases
quests.offer: Two enchantresses, Esmirique and Snylvia, fight over a man south of Qeynos. And Dragoon Tyr'win in the Green Rift accuses the necromancer Warpheus in Collonridge Cemetery. Find the guilty and bring me proof.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Esmirique on the shore south of Qeynos, two trees south of the poachers' camp.
steps.says: Drake is mine! Snylvia will never have him, and neither will you!

steps.journal: Defeat Esmirique and take her staff.
Find Necromancer Warpheus in the elder's tomb of Collonridge Cemetery, by the crumbling bones.
steps.says: Tyr'win sent you? Rover! An ancient death for our guest!

steps.journal: Destroy the ancient death Warpheus calls.
Defeat Necromancer Warpheus and take his ring.
Bring the staff and the ring to Judicial Advisor Lot in Hazinak.
steps.says: Both guilty, as you found. One last pair of cases.

quests.name: Superior Intellect: Three Riddles
quests.offer: Answer my riddles with things, not words. On and on, with I between. Four fingers and a thumb, not flesh nor fowl. My life is measured in hours; when I am aglow, wind is my foe. Bring me all three.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Buy onions from Farmer Moegar in Druid's Watch for 1200 tunar.
steps.says: Onions! Here you are.

steps.journal: Take a glove from the bandits in the hills by Darvar Manor.
Take a candle from the freezing goblins in the cave between Halas and Castle Lightwolf.
Bring the onions, the glove and the candle to Inquiladius Expica outside Druid's Watch.
steps.says: Onions, a glove, a candle. Correct, all three. Your mind is quick.

quests.offer: Three puzzles, and 2500 tunar for my trouble. Pass the runner in second place: what medal is yours? How many oranges did you eat? And at what level is the orc pawn? Bring me the medal, the oranges and the belts.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Pay Inquiladius Expica 2500 tunar to go on.
steps.says: Thank you. Now think. The Nasehirs of Al'Farak Ruins hand out the medals.

steps.journal: Take the medal for second place from the Nasehirs in Al'Farak Ruins.
Buy the bag of oranges you ate from Farmer Moegar for 4000 tunar.
steps.says: The bag of four? Here you are.

steps.journal: Take three crude Deathfist belts from the Deathfist orcs: the pawn's level.
Bring the silver medal, the four oranges and three Deathfist belts to Inquiladius Expica.
steps.says: Silver, four and three. You did not guess, you worked it out.

steps.journal: Find the dwarf Grunnie in Darvar Manor ('Feswes Nepus'), left of the coach by the fence.
steps.says: You worked it out! The ring is yours to carry.

steps.journal: Find the elf Cylen in Blackwater ('Cmedixevis'), by the fence near Corliss.
steps.says: Clever. Here is the pouch.

steps.journal: Find the gnome Kibenza in Gertar's Mines ('Hispves Nopit'), east of the coach by the merchants.
steps.says: A rune for a riddle solved. Take it.

steps.journal: Find Sawise in Kara Village ('Lese Wommehi'), south of the west entrance by a tree.
steps.says: The note, then. It would never fit on a finger.

steps.journal: Bring the ring, the pouch, the rune and the note to Inquiladius Expica.
steps.says: Every name in its place. One test remains.

quests.name: Superior Intellect: The Memory Test
quests.offer: Spend some time in Dshinn's Redoubt, among its dead, and remember what you see. Then let Demetricus Olious, a few steps north of me, test your memory. Answer wrongly, and you die.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Tell Inquiladius Expica you know Dshinn's Redoubt well enough.
steps.says: Do you? Then go to Demetricus, a few steps north. Thirty seconds a question.

steps.journal: Take Demetricus Olious's memory test, a few steps north of Inquiladius Expica.
steps.says: Ten questions, ten right answers. Remarkable. Go back to Inquiladius.

steps.journal: Return to Inquiladius Expica.
steps.says: A perfect memory. Your mind is as sharp as mine.

quests.name: Razzle Dazzle: Yiggua's Love
quests.offer: Charm is helping others say what they cannot. Yiggua, north of the outpost outside Grobb, has quarreled with the troll she loves. Talk to her, then to him, and mend it. Kindly, mind.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Yiggua off the path north of the little outpost outside Grobb.
steps.says: I missed our meeting and now he will not look at me. He is a shadowknight. He loves froglok legs with drawn butter.

steps.journal: Find Shuglug on the beach round the mountain east of Grobb.
steps.says: She was sick? And shy? Froglegs and butter would mend it. Get me some butter.
steps.answer: You look sad. Want to talk?

steps.journal: Ask Farmer Rulug in Kerplunk Outpost for butter.
steps.says: Butter costs. Bring me three stunned hearty boars from the river west of Ruddish the Devout.

steps.journal: Stun three hearty boars along the river in the western Spider Mines.
Bring the three stunned boars to Farmer Rulug.
steps.says: Three fine boars. Here is your butter.

steps.journal: Bring the drawn butter to Shuglug.
steps.says: Froglegs and butter for two. Tell her I will be there.

steps.journal: Tell Yiggua the good news.
steps.says: He will? Oh, thank you!

steps.journal: Return to Sylanthia De'Crevast in North Kithicor.
steps.says: Love mended. You have a gift.

quests.name: Razzle Dazzle: Fripz and Frapz
quests.offer: Two brothers at Oggok Gate, Fripz and Frapz, are close to killing each other over a joke. Talk them down. Carry their words between them until each says he is sorry.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Fripz at Oggok Gate (S).
steps.says: He mocked me! I will crush him!
steps.answer: While it is quite rude, it's not worth death...

steps.journal: Find Frapz on a hillside among the ponds of Oggok Gate (NE).
steps.says: It was a joke! A good one! Well... maybe not then.
steps.answer: It could be funny. But only at the proper time.

steps.journal: Carry Frapz's words back to Fripz.
steps.says: Fine. I write I am sorry, if he is sorry. Give him this.
steps.answer: Maybe you have both done some regretful things

steps.journal: Bring Fripz's note to Frapz.
steps.says: He is sorry? Then so am I. Tell him.

steps.journal: Tell Fripz his brother is sorry too.
steps.says: Brother. Hmph. Brothers, then.

steps.journal: Return to Sylanthia De'Crevast in North Kithicor.
steps.says: Two brothers, and no blood spilled.

quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Sweggy inside the Last Inn.
steps.says: A ring? Talk is thirsty work. Buy me a drink.

steps.journal: Buy Sweggy a drink from the Bartender for 400 tunar.
steps.says: One ale.

steps.journal: Give Sweggy the ale.
steps.says: Ahh. The ring? Pay my tab and it is yours.

steps.journal: Settle Sweggy's tab with the Bartender: 6700 tunar.
steps.says: Paid in full. Funny, though: Sweggy says the ring is gone.

steps.journal: Hear Waitress Jitzle's story.
steps.says: I never touched it. The Bartender was near his table all night.

steps.journal: Hear Roerx's story.
steps.says: Me? I was drinking. Ask the one behind the bar.

steps.journal: Tell Sweggy who stole the ring.
steps.says: The Bartender! Here, take the ring before anyone else does.

steps.journal: Bring the ring to Sylanthia De'Crevast in North Kithicor.
steps.says: My ring! And no one was hurt.

quests.offer: Agead, out the back door of Freeport, must give a speech. Help him write it. When it is given, those who oppose it will rise: their leader Aryee is in Northern Ro. Bring me her staff, by any means.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Help Agead write his speech, out Freeport's back door at the north-east corner.

steps.says: It went well, but a rebellion forms. Aryee leads it, on a hill by the stone markers in Northern Ro (W).

steps.journal: Find Aryee on a hill by a set of stone markers in Northern Ro (W).
steps.says: Negotiate? The speech was lies. Then we fight!

steps.journal: Defeat Aryee and take her staff.
Bring Aryee's staff to Sylanthia De'Crevast in North Kithicor.
steps.says: It is done. Few can talk a city into peace. You can.

quests.name: Binding an Elemental
quests.offer: That book on my shelf? Strange old thing, about binding an elemental. Take it if you like, but you will need a scholar to read it. Try the enchanters' guild in Freeport.
quests.declined: The book stays where it is.

steps.journal: Take the book to Scholar Narielle in the enchanters' guild of Freeport to be translated.
steps.says: This book tells how to bind an air elemental into an item. First we need a simple weapon. Smithy Grol, behind the blacksmith in Highpass, sells them.

steps.journal: Get a simple weapon from Smithy Grol, behind the blacksmith in Highpass.
steps.says: A simple blade, rod or mace? Take the one you can use.

steps.journal: Bring the simple weapon to Scholar Narielle.
steps.says: Good. Now two mechanamagical parts: a fan blade and five arcanic regulators. Rogue Clockworks has both.

steps.journal: Catch tiny spiderbots in the north-east of Rogue Clockworks for five arcanic regulators.
Find the shiny clockworks on the hill with a huge signpost east of there, and take a fan blade.
Bring the shiny fan blade and the five arcanic regulators to Scholar Narielle.
steps.says: Now the elemental itself must be lured. It prizes its chimes: bring me three from the gusts in the ravine east of Wyndhaven's coach.

steps.journal: Run the ravine east of Wyndhaven's coach until the gusts come, and take three gust chimes.
Bring the three gust chimes to Scholar Narielle.
steps.says: Everything is ready. Take it all to Arcanist Ghibkin in Highpass, in the banker's room behind the siege engine.

steps.journal: Find Arcanist Ghibkin in Highpass, in the banker's room behind the siege engine.
steps.says: An air elemental, bound in a simple weapon. Here, it is done. When it strikes, the Gust comes.

steps.journal: Tell The Storyteller in Baga Village (NE), by the well, what you did.
steps.says: An elemental in a blade! A fine tale.

quests.name: The Excavations of Snowblind
quests.offer: The orcs and the ice giants dig at our borders, and the Anu do not forget a friend. First, walk to the south shore of the lake north of the village, where the Ice Tomb lies, and tell me what you see.
quests.declined: Then go. The Anu remember who helps them.

steps.journal: Go to the south edge of the lake by the Ice Tomb, north of Anu Village.

events.text: Across the frozen lake, by the Ice Tomb, you see fresh digging, and tracks that lead away west.

steps.journal: Tell Ulfar Styrkarson what you saw.
steps.says: Digging, by the tomb? Vargilder must hear of it.

steps.journal: Find Vargilder Souralld in a small tent across the frozen lake, Anu Village (SW).
steps.says: Orcs and giants, digging for the old things. The Varchief must decide. Go to him.

steps.journal: Find Varchief Steinoff in Anu Village (N), by the three houses in a row.
steps.says: We will blow their digs to pieces. Head Engineer Silos at the observatory knows who has the means.

steps.journal: Find Head Engineer Silos at the observatory north-east of Anu Village.
steps.says: Dynamite! Demolitionist Osbit sells it, at Snafizer's House. Bring 10,000 tunar.

steps.journal: Buy two sticks of dynamite from Demolitionist Osbit for 10,000 tunar.
steps.says: Two sticks. Do not drop them.

steps.journal: Return to Varchief Steinoff with the dynamite.
steps.says: Now kill Warlord Treg and Prophet Olvadr Korskr, and blow up the digs they guard.

steps.journal: Kill Warlord Treg on the hill of Frosteyes west of Anu Village.
Set a stick of dynamite at the Orc Excavation Site.
steps.says: The dig goes up in a roar of snow and stone.

steps.journal: Kill Prophet Olvadr Korskr at the dark tower in Snowblind Plains (W).
Set the last stick at the ice giants' excavation site.
steps.says: The giants' dig collapses on itself.

steps.journal: Return to Varchief Steinoff in Anu Village.
steps.says: Both digs gone, both leaders dead. The Anu Village will remember. Take this, friend of the Anu.

quests.name: The Legend of Altivo
quests.offer: You want power? My father Jebdo knows how to enchant a sword. Take this useless one and my note to him, in the desert they call Tak. Help Corison with his glyphs, and we will see.

steps.journal: Find Jebdo Stikala's ghost by the river in Tak 'Xiv West (SE), west of Oasis.
steps.says: My son, still greedy. Hear instead of my father Altivo, who slew the dragon Rataku with his last breath. Tell his legend to five, and have each sign that they will tell five more.

steps.journal: Guard Morgin, on Hazinak's bridge, is hungry: bring him a tunaria bass from the river.
steps.says: A bass! Now I can listen. There, I signed it.

steps.journal: Find Jol the Fat by the guard house beside Da Shoppe in Honjour.
steps.says: I am cold, not deaf. Fine, a legend. Signed.

steps.journal: Find Magluza's shiny rock in the swamp water south-west of her hill, by Baga Village.

events.text: At the edge of the second pool your fingers close on a shiny rock.

steps.journal: Bring Magluza her shiny rock, on the hill with the T stone.
steps.says: My prudy rock! You tell your story, I sign.

steps.journal: Pay Guard Zex at Fort Seriak 5000 tunar to hear the legend.
steps.says: Ha! I will tell it to the lads as a joke. Signed.

steps.journal: Give the Gal`Saris knight in the green tent by the cave in the Green Rift (W) an aurabound shield.
steps.says: A fine shield. Your story? Yes, yes. Signed.

steps.journal: Bring the five signed promises to Jebdo Stikala.
steps.says: The legend lives. You are the child I should have had. Take my son this note: it tells how to enchant the sword.

steps.journal: Bring Jebdo's note to Sundro Stikala in Zentar's Keep.
steps.says: My father? He is dead, I sent you to be rid of you! Well. To finish, I need a frost from the arctic giants, and four frost giant staves.

quests.offer: To finish the enchantment I need a frost, the kind the arctic giants' casters carry, and four frost giant staves from the tenacious giants' camps. Bring them.
quests.declined: Then do not come back empty-handed.
quests.started: The giants are in Snowblind Plains.

steps.journal: Kill tenacious frost giants until an Arctic Spiritcaller comes, and take its frost.
Take four frost giant staves from the tenacious frost giant camps in Snowblind Plains (S).
Bring the frost and the four staves to Sundro Stikala.
steps.says: Ha! You fool, the sword was always mine. Still, you did it. Go up the ramp: Zentar Reese will see you.

steps.journal: Go up the ramp to Zentar Reese.
steps.says: Sundro needed a lesson in humility, and you gave it. Take this for your devotion.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/zentars-keep-pet.json, # Zentar's Keep Pet Quest, steps 9-11 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's frost item is an archetype's own (tanks' Frost Emblem, melees' Frost Talisman, casters' Frost Essence, healers' Frost Rune) with a stack that differs too: one frost and four frost giant staves (the melees') for every class here. The Arctic Spiritcaller stands at the camp (FrontiersForge saw one) instead of spawning in a giant's place; the Arctic Adept is left out. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the archetype rewards (tanks' Snow Fighter, melees' Snow Gladiator, casters' snowman form) and their recharge.

quests.name: Escaping Kerran
quests.offer: Our escape was betrayed! Someone in Freeport sold the plans. Find Setham on the docks there, by the waysenders to Odus. He was to help us. Find out who betrayed us.

steps.journal: Find Setham on Freeport's docks, with the waysenders to Odus.
steps.says: Betrayed? Then it was Balidos. He stands against a tree in Paineel (S), north of Oakbrow. Tell him you came about a job.

steps.journal: Find Balidos against a tree in Paineel (S) and tell him you came about a job.
steps.says: A job? You came for me! Die!

steps.journal: Defeat Balidos and take his papers.
Bring Balidos's papers to Setham on Freeport's docks.
steps.says: These name Naris, in Paineel (SE), just east of the escapee. Go carefully: his recovery agents guard him.

steps.journal: Find Naris in Paineel (SE), guarded by three Paineel recovery agents.
steps.says: An agent of the Kerran? My orders are with my men. Take them if you can.

steps.journal: Take the orders off a Paineel recovery agent.
Bring the orders to Naris.
steps.says: So you have them. Arjinn Jais, on a hill in Bandit Hills (NW), keeps a stone for those with the code.

steps.journal: Find Arjinn Jais on a hill west of the bandit camp in Bandit Hills (NW) and give him the code.
steps.says: The right code. Take the stone to whoever sent you.

steps.journal: Bring Arjinn's stone to Naris.
steps.says: Now go to Mikti, in the big black brick building at the east edge of the fort, Paineel (W).

steps.journal: Find Mikti down the ramp of the black brick building at the fort, Paineel (W).
steps.says: Maous ran. The orb took care of the rest. Go back to Naris: he is not what he seems.

steps.journal: Return to Naris in Paineel (SE).
steps.says: You fool. General Dorganun, kill this one!

steps.journal: Kill General Dorganun.
Return to Setham on Freeport's docks.
steps.says: Naris betrayed us all along. The Kerran are free because of you. Take what you need.

steps.journal: Tell The Storyteller in Baga Village (NE), by the well, the tale.
steps.says: Betrayal and escape! A fine tale.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/paineel.json, # Paineel Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide gives no level or class: level 45 here (its recovery agents are red to a 60). Balidos's items (the guide's talk after his death) are his drop here; the popup needed to talk to Naris is left out. A wrong code (6642a is right) would have you kill Arjinn: left out. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: Setham's choice of nine items (Str/Dex ... HP/Pwr; the AC/HP one is the Acaesdin Choker): the engine cannot offer a choice, and none of the nine is in itempattern.

quests.name: The Code of the Old Scroll
quests.offer: A traveller named Nolram Barro camps on a hill at the north-west corner outside Takish'Hiz. He carries an old scroll in a code I have long wanted. Bring it to me, and we will see what it hides.
quests.declined: Then the code keeps its secret.

steps.journal: Kill Nolram Barro on the hill at the north-west corner outside Takish'Hiz (C).
Show the old scroll to William Nothard in Freeport.
steps.says: A code. In Takish'Hiz, where Lord Chardith rises, a book behind the archmagus tells how to read it.

steps.journal: Read the book behind the archmagus at Lord Chardith's spawn point, Takish'Hiz (SE).

events.text: The book explains the code. As you read, something stirs behind you!

steps.journal: Kill the Dead Acolyte.
Return to William Nothard in Freeport with what the code says.
steps.says: 'The secret lies within the tombs of the Rowen'dal. An incredible power waits to be unleashed.' The Tomb of Kings, then.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/the-temple-of-light.json, # The Temple of Light Quest, steps 1-4 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's first popup (the quest received near Nolram's camp) is this giver: the guide says Nothard gives it anyway. Nayr Nonnahs and Rian Buesh, who camp with Nolram, are left out (only he is killed). The book's popup is a reach step at Lord Chardith's spawn point.

quests.name: The Tomb of the Rowen'dal
quests.offer: The Tomb of Kings holds what the scroll speaks of. Find the room with the kings and open the chest there. Then follow wherever it leads.
quests.accept: I will go to the Tomb of Kings.

steps.journal: Open the chest in the room with the kings in the Tomb of Kings.

events.text: The chest is empty. A voice behind you: "Looking for what was in it?"

steps.journal: Kill the Excavation Leader.
Climb to the top of the ramp leading into Neriak and speak with the Stranger.
steps.says: The Excavation Leader shipped it to Neriak. Come with me.

steps.journal: Speak with Kizdean Gix in Neriak (E).
steps.says: The tome is torn. An old man in Permafrost, west of Castle Vox, as far north as the coast goes, has a page.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/the-temple-of-light.json, # The Temple of Light Quest, steps 5-7 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's entry popup ('you have received a quest') and its chest, which spawns the Excavation Leader, are one reach step in the kings' room here (at the excavation team's place). The Stranger's port is a teleport to Kizdean Gix.

quests.name: The Dercas Emot
quests.offer: The Dercas Emot, the sacred tome, was torn apart and hidden. An old man in Permafrost (NW) keeps a page. He has bodyguards. Get the page, have it read in Freeport, find the piece, and bring it to me.
quests.declined: Then the tome stays in pieces.

steps.journal: Find the Old Man on the coast of Permafrost (NW), west of Castle Vox.

events.text: "Stay away!" Bodyguards come at you.

steps.journal: Kill the Old Man's bodyguards.
Speak with the Old Man on the coast of Permafrost (NW).
steps.says: Fine, take the page. The key to reading it is in Freeport.

steps.journal: Show the ripped page to Nebur Hael, who roams Freeport's inn.
steps.says: 'Land of the reptiles that walk like men... arrangements made to keep it off the mainlands.' Dinbak, south.

steps.journal: Find the Dercas Warden and his chest in Dinbak (S).
steps.says: You know of the Emot? Then the piece is yours.

steps.journal: Bring the page and the piece to Kizdean Gix in Neriak (E).
steps.says: At last! But we are not alone. Its guardian wakes!

steps.journal: Kill the Dead Guardian.
Speak with Kizdean Gix again.
steps.says: Now, to the Temple of Light. Sir Roger Rodgers guards the way.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/the-temple-of-light.json, # The Temple of Light Quest, steps 8-11 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's five bodyguards (drake guards, unnamed) are three Voxite mages here, the creature FrontiersForge saw at the Old Man's spot (dark blue to a 60). The old man hands out one of three pages at random; the second (Dinbak, the Dercas Warden and his chest, no fight) is the one here.

quests.name: The Temple of Light
quests.offer: The way is open. Go to the Temple of Light and face Sir Roger Rodgers. He will not let you pass alive, so he must fall. Then come back to me.

steps.journal: Speak with Sir Roger Rodgers at the Temple of Light.
steps.says: Kizdean sent you? Then you have been used, and you will die for it!

steps.journal: Kill Sir Roger Rodgers.
Return to Kizdean Gix in Neriak (E).
steps.says: You have been used, and well. Here is your pay. Now go: the docks of Freeport.

steps.journal: Tell The Storyteller in Baga Village (NE), by the well, the tale.
steps.says: Used by a dark elf, and lived to tell it! A fine tale.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/the-temple-of-light.json, # The Temple of Light Quest, steps 12-13 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's port to Freeport's docks is a teleport by Setham's dock. The quest is not repeatable (the guide).

quests.name: The Ring of Madrias: Earth and Stone
quests.offer: I am making something for you, a ring that grows with you. It needs things only you can gather. First, two ores: the earth spirits on the mountain in Highbourne (SE) carry them. Kill the earths until the spirits come.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: The mountain is to the south-east.

steps.journal: Kill enraged and shambling earths on the mountain in Highbourne (SE) until the spirits come.
Kill the mountain spirits for two ores.
Bring the two ores to Madrias Tam on Highbourne's docks.
steps.says: Good. Now a gem. Talk to the sunbaked stone in Highbourne (E), north of the mountain's base.

steps.journal: Talk to the sunbaked stone in Highbourne (E), just north of the mountain's base.
steps.says: The stone stirs, and bugs pour out of the cracks!

steps.journal: Kill the bugs from the stone for an uncut gem.
Take the uncut gem to the gem polisher on Highbourne's docks.
steps.says: To polish this I need the dust of the lost souls in the necromancers' guild.

steps.journal: Take soul dust from the lost souls in Highbourne's necromancers' guild.
Bring the soul dust to the gem polisher.
steps.says: There. Polished.

steps.journal: Bring the polished gem to Madrias Tam.
steps.says: Beautiful. Last, three bloods of the lion pride on the majestic rock in Highbourne (NW).

steps.journal: Take three lion's bloods from Abyas's pride on the rock in Highbourne (NW).
Bring the three lion's bloods to Madrias Tam.
steps.says: Your first ring. It will grow with you, if you keep helping me.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/highbourne-for-the-ring.json, # HIGHBOURNE QUEST, the level 20 ring (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's reward for this ring is a spell that summons a no-rent ring for your archetype, and 'a little xp' with no figure: no such spell is on this server and the experience is not given, so this part gives nothing but the next. The guide does not name what the polisher wants or the bugs: the lost souls' dust (the guide's undead in the necromancers' guild) and the elusive stone ants by the stone are ours. Abyas, who also drops blood, stands with the pride.

quests.name: The Ring of Madrias: The Master of the Forge
quests.offer: Your ring must be forged anew. Seek the Master of the Forge, south of a sea that isn't on the skull's spine. Do what he asks.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: South of a sea that isn't on the skull's spine.

steps.journal: Find the Master of the Forge: Hermit Washburn in Brokenskull Rock (SW).
steps.says: Madrias's ring? Take my pickaxe. Dig in the cemetery of the Burial Mounds (S) for three ores.

steps.journal: Dig at the graves in the cemetery of the Burial Mounds (S) for three ores.

events.text: Graves give up their ore to the pickaxe: three ores.

steps.journal: Bring the three ores to Hermit Washburn.
steps.says: Good ore. Now I need a mallet: Urtica Dioica, a centaur on a hill of treants in Spirit Talker's Woods (C), carries an old one.

steps.journal: Take the archaic mallet from Urtica Dioica in Spirit Talker's Woods (C).
Bring the archaic mallet to Hermit Washburn.
steps.says: Now it is forged. Take it back to Madrias.

steps.journal: Return to Madrias Tam on Highbourne's docks.
steps.says: Forged anew. Your second ring.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/highbourne-for-the-ring.json, # HIGHBOURNE QUEST, the level 30 ring (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's reward for this ring is a spell that summons a no-rent ring for your archetype, and 'a little xp' with no figure: no such spell is on this server and the experience is not given, so this part gives nothing but the next. The guide's '?' at the graves (talked to until three ores come) is one reach step with a popup.

quests.name: The Ring of Madrias: Magus Niska's Books
quests.offer: Magus Niska, in the necromancers' guild in Klick'Anon, has lost four books of lore, one from each of the humans, the gnomes, the Erudites and the Teir'dal. Help him, and your ring grows.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Find Magus Niska in the necromancers' guild in Klick'Anon.
steps.says: My books! Znib's Journal, the Compendium of Energy, the Magi Libellus and Harlog's Formulea. Search the bookcases of Freeport, Highbourne, Klick'Anon and Neriak.

steps.journal: Search the bookcase in Freeport's casters' guild.
steps.says: Among the dusty tomes: the Compendium of Energy.

steps.journal: Search the bookcases of Highbourne's library.

events.text: On a library shelf you find the Magi Libellus.

steps.journal: Search the bookcases of Klick'Anon's guilds.

events.text: Behind other books: Znib's Journal.

steps.journal: Search the bookcases of Neriak's clerics' guild.

events.text: In a Teir'dal bookcase: Harlog's Formulea.

steps.journal: Bring the four books to Magus Niska in Klick'Anon.
steps.says: All four! Tell Madrias he has my thanks.

steps.journal: Return to Madrias Tam on Highbourne's docks.
steps.says: Niska is grateful. Your third ring.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/highbourne-for-the-ring.json, # HIGHBOURNE QUEST, the level 40 ring (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's reward for this ring is a spell that summons a no-rent ring for your archetype, and 'a little xp' with no figure: no such spell is on this server and the experience is not given, so this part gives nothing but the next. The guide's bookcases (Freeport, Darvar Manor, Highbourne, Neriak, Qeynos, Klick'Anon) are four here, one a race; which book is in which town is ours. Freeport's is the dusty tome in its casters' guild.

quests.name: The Ring of Madrias: The Great Three
quests.offer: Three restless dead, the Great Three, must be laid down. Shepherd Brook, by the ramp up into Moradhim, knows where they lie. Bring their soul shards.
quests.accept: I will lay them to rest.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Shepherd Brook is by Moradhim's ramp.

steps.journal: Find Shepherd Brook by the ramp up into Moradhim.
steps.says: The first lies in the graveyard by the windmill on the lake's south-west side in Rivervale. Call it out and bring me its shard.

steps.journal: Destroy the unsettled bones in Rivervale's graveyard by the windmill.
Bring the soul shard of Mataias to Shepherd Brook.
steps.says: The second rests on a hill near the shooting range in Surefall Glade, by a giant stone marker.

steps.journal: Destroy the unsettled bones on the hill near Surefall Glade's shooting range.
Bring the soul shard of Sarilasra to Shepherd Brook.
steps.says: The last of the Great Three is in the northern cemetery: Collonridge (E), in the blue mist.

steps.journal: Destroy the unsettled bones in the blue mist of Collonridge Cemetery (E).
Bring the soul shard of Val'Anath to Shepherd Brook.
steps.says: All three at rest. Go back to Madrias.

steps.journal: Return to Madrias Tam on Highbourne's docks.
steps.says: The Great Three are at peace. Your fourth ring.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/highbourne-for-the-ring.json, # HIGHBOURNE QUEST, the level 50 ring (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's reward for this ring is a spell that summons a no-rent ring for your archetype, and 'a little xp' with no figure: no such spell is on this server and the experience is not given, so this part gives nothing but the next. The three unsettled bones share a name: each shard drops off any of them while its step is the one to do (the engine matches a target by name).

quests.name: The Ring of Madrias: The Dark Lord
quests.offer: One last ring. Seven things: three sulfursits from near Laknar, three necrotic remains from the death's head beetles of Envar, and the Bone of the Dark Lord, which Douglas Aren in Paineel will sell you. Then we end it.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.

steps.journal: Gather three sulfursits near Laknar.

events.text: Near Laknar you prise three lumps of sulfursit from the rock.

steps.journal: Take three necrotic remains from the death's head beetles of Envar.
Talk Douglas Aren in Paineel out of the Bone of the Dark Lord, for 30,000 tunar.
steps.says: Sold, then. The bone is in the box on my table: take it.

steps.journal: Bring the three sulfursits, three necrotic remains and the bone to Madrias Tam.
steps.says: Everything. Meet me in Castle Felstar (W). The Dark Lord I have spoken of all along waits there.

steps.journal: Meet Madrias Tam in Castle Felstar (W).

events.text: Madrias raises the bone and calls out. Vhi'zan Kaah, the Dark Lord, answers!

steps.journal: Kill Vhi'zan Kaah and take his essence.
Speak with the Ghost of Madrias in Castle Felstar.
steps.says: It is over. I can rest now. Take your last ring, and remember me.

steps.journal: Tell The Storyteller in Baga Village (NE), by the well, the whole tale.
steps.says: Five rings and a Dark Lord! The finest tale I have heard.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/highbourne-for-the-ring.json, # HIGHBOURNE QUEST, the level 60 ring (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The tanks' ring, The Stoneheart, is given to warriors, paladins and shadowknights. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: The Nexus (casters), The Soulstone (healers) and The Wildheart (melees); the guide's 'little xp' has no figure. The whole quest's 240 Storyteller faction is given at its end. Laknar's '?' that gives the sulfursits is a reach step with a popup. Douglas Aren's questions (trick him into selling) are a payment here; he stands by Paineel's banker (the guide's tent by the main house). Madrias's summoning in Castle Felstar is a reach step; Vhi'zan Kaah comes with two of his five minions.

quests.name: The History of Sheythorpe
quests.offer: The History of Sheythorpe, both volumes, was taken from us. The dogs that roam here, Rex and Fido, carried them off. Bring them back to me, please.

steps.journal: Take the first volume of the History of Sheythorpe from Rex.
Take the second volume of the History of Sheythorpe from Fido.
Bring both volumes to Heather Johns.
steps.says: Both! Ken Black will want to know they are safe. Go to him.

steps.journal: Speak with Ken Black.
steps.says: Rian was asking after Grocer Fern in Forkwatch. Ask her what he wanted.

steps.journal: Ask Grocer Fern in Forkwatch about Rian.
steps.says: Rian? He bought supplies for a long stay and went east.

steps.journal: Return to Ken Black.
steps.says: A long stay... Karne Johns may know where. Ask him.

steps.journal: Speak with Karne Johns.
steps.says: My brother has a secret hiding place: east along the river to the bridge in Desert Hate.

steps.journal: Find Rian's hiding place by the bridge in Desert Hate (keep to the river's left side).
steps.says: Found me, have you? Take my journal to Heather. She will understand.

steps.journal: Bring Rian's journal to Heather Johns.
steps.says: He is alive. Thank you, truly.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/heather-johns.json, # Heather Johns Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's dogs are Rex and Fido here, the two named dogs of Dshinn's Redoubt, a volume each. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Ring of Knowledge" (Wis+15 Str+30, level 48).

quests.name: Sea of Lions
quests.offer: The lion guards of the tunnels at the zone's heart serve a master who would see me dead. One of them, one who carries no weapon, wears a medallion I need. Bring it to me.

steps.journal: Take the medallion from a lion guard without a weapon in the tunnels at the centre of the Sea of Lions.
Bring the medallion to Kithrin in his mountain cave in the north-west.
steps.says: Good. Now four things of the antlions: a fur, a talon, a poison sac and a scale. Their caves are all over.

steps.journal: Take an antlion's fur.
Take an antlion's talon.
Take an antlion's poison sac.
Take an antlion's scale.
Bring the four antlion parts to Kithrin.
steps.says: Now go to their overseer, where the lion guards are. Talk to him, and then end him.

steps.journal: Speak with the overseer where the lion guards are.
steps.says: Kithrin's errand runner? Die!

steps.journal: Kill the overseer.
Kill the antlion queen that comes at his death.
Return to Kithrin.
steps.says: Their master's plans are ruined. Wear this, and remember me.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/sea-of-lions.json, # Sea of Lions Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's lion guards are the Lionguard brigands and cultists here (the medallion off the unarmed cultists), its Overseer Geesah the game's Overseer Gennan. The antlions' caves are wherever they stand. The quest gives no experience (the guide).

quests.name: The Lost Fisherman
quests.offer: My man Cedric never came back from Cape Dreg. Find him, on the isles to the east there. Find out what happened, and bring me word.

steps.journal: Find Cedric on one of the isles of Cape Dreg (E).
steps.says: You came for my head? No? Then help me: a rare giant skuttlespike swallowed my strongbox.

steps.journal: Find the rare giant skuttlespike on the islands of Cape Dreg and take the strongbox.
Bring the strongbox to Cedric.
steps.says: My strongbox! Here, the captain's reward is mine to give. Tell him I am well.

steps.journal: Return to Captain Longley on the docks of the Stone of Morthalis.
steps.says: Cedric lives! Then all is well.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/stone-of-morthalis.json, # Stone of Morthalis Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's choice (slay Cedric for his head, or help him; the same reward either way) is the helping branch here. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Vordan Ring" (STA 40, HPMax 50, POW 50, level 54).

quests.name: Fugi's Friend
quests.offer: CQNN AKE THUU MA THQULV? The ogre keeps him below the ground. But first: FRU NYHSUMKEFR XKFFNUTQGR GCYNNKCUV FRU TUHFQNQZUH. (Fungusmen speak in code: y is a, x is b, w is c... z is z.)

steps.journal: Fugi says the largemouth bottlefish swallowed the fertilizer: they swim round the bridge with the lizardmen to the south.
Bring the fertilizer to Fugi Bactor.
steps.says: XHQLS TESQ Y XKFFNU KT CYFUH THKM FRU CYFUHXKA. (Bring Fugi a bottle of water from the waterboy.)

steps.journal: Buy a bottle of water from the waterboy among the lizardmen south-west, for 1050 tunar.
steps.says: One bottle. Fresh!

steps.journal: Bring the bottle of water to Fugi Bactor.
steps.says: He has been a slave for many years. Go to the cave with ghouls, west. Tell him you are there to free him.

steps.journal: Find the fungusman slave in the cave with ghouls to the west and tell him you are there to free him.
steps.says: Free? After so long? Thank you! Tell Fugi I am coming.
steps.answer: I am here to free you.

steps.journal: Return to Fugi Bactor.
steps.says: Q CQNN LUDUH TKHSUF. (I will never forget.)

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/west-feerot.json, # West Feerot Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's coded dialogue (its key: y=a, x=b, w=c ... a=y, z=z) is kept in Fugi's lines, the answer "Q CQNN." ('I will.') too. The places are ours, from the guide's directions out of Oggok's south gate (the Rathe). The guide names no reward (Fugi promises 'great wisdom').

quests.name: Thenon the Wise
quests.offer: I was a king. Lothaxae and his cult took my remains and trapped my soul in a gem. Take this staff. Find the essence gems Amandon and the Ghoul Reaver carry, pass the statue below, and destroy Lothaxae. Free me.
quests.declined: Then I wait, as I have waited.

steps.journal: Take the essence emerald from Amandon, in the barrow's halls to the left.
Take the essence ruby from the Ghoul Reaver.
Give the statue at the bottom of the barrow the two gems and the staff.
steps.says: The statue grinds aside.

steps.journal: Kill Lothaxae in the room past the statue and take the soul gem.
Bring the soul gem to Thenon the Wise.
steps.says: Free! At last I can rest. Take this, and my thanks.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/thenon-the-wise.json, # Thenon the Wise Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's unnamed 45+ necromancer past the statue is Lothaxae here (the cult leader Thenon names). The statue is the barrow's Golem Statue. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the crown (20-30 WIS).

quests.name: The Truearrow Brooch
quests.offer: Any business to discuss? So you are the mercenary I sent for. Good. I need a killer: the leader of the Tier'dal camp near the ruins of Oasis, in Takish'Hiz. Bring me his brooch as proof.
quests.accept: I am the mercenary you sent for.
quests.declined: Then go away. I am busy.

steps.journal: Kill the Truearrows in the tents on the hill in Takish'Hiz until Cyrian Truearrow comes, and take his brooch.
Bring the brooch to Taszin K'Ven on the inn's second floor in Hazinak.
steps.says: Well done, mercenary. Your pay, and something pretty.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/the-truearrow.json, # The Truearrow Quest, steps 1-4 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Taszin's dialogue ('I don't know, do we?', 'I am the mercenary you sent for') is the offer and its answer. Cyrian Truearrow stands at the camp (the guide: he comes after the tents are farmed a while). The guide's -500 faction with Pulanga is left out: no such faction on this server. The statue is a made item (it has no stats in the guide).

quests.name: Pulanga's Deal
quests.offer: You killed the Truearrow? Then you owe me 25,000 tunar, or your life. Or... we work out a deal. A rival of mine, Gobzen, hides in a backroom in Honjour. Kill him, and we are square.
quests.accept: Let us work out a deal.

steps.journal: Kill Gobzen in a backroom in Honjour.
Return to Pulanga on the ground floor of Hazinak's inn.
steps.says: Gobzen is dead? Then we are square.

quests.name: The Illusionist
quests.offer: Townspeople go missing from Highpass, and no one knows why. Investigator Flint, at the first guard tower on the road south to Trail's End, has been looking into it. Find out what he knows.

steps.journal: Find Investigator Flint at the first guard tower on the road south to Trail's End.
steps.says: A conspiracy, in Highpass itself! Here are my notes. Fetch me griffon's blood from the enchanters, and...

steps.journal: Tell Investigator Ishal of Flint's conspiracy and show him the notes.
steps.says: Flint's notes, hm. And Utmoor's bodyguard went missing this morning. The rangers track him: help them.

steps.journal: Find Ranger Mek in Mossmouth (SW), close to the mountains, out the Pickclaw gate.
steps.says: I tracked the goblins this far, but I cannot take them alone. They are a bow-shot north, between two trees.

steps.journal: Kill the two goblin warriors between the trees north of Ranger Mek.
Kill the goblin shaman, and stand near him as he falls.

events.text: On the shaman you find the bodyguard's ring, and a note in Flint's hand. Flint is behind it!

steps.journal: Return to Investigator Ishal.
steps.says: Flint! Then arrest him. He will not come quietly.

steps.journal: Arrest Investigator Flint at the guard tower.
steps.says: Clever. Too clever. See me as I am: Akista Sind!

steps.journal: Kill Akista Sind, the illusionist.
Return to Investigator Ishal.
steps.says: Akista Sind, wearing Flint's face all along. Highpass is in your debt.

steps.journal: Tell The Storyteller in Baga Village (NE), by the well, the tale.
steps.says: An illusionist unmasked! A fine tale.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/the-illusionist.json, # The Illusionist Quest, path A i) (Ishal's side) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's quest branches three ways (Ishal's side, Flint's side through Enchanter Kerina and the mature griffon, and 'when a reward is involved' through the courier and Flint's cave): the engine has no choice of outcomes, so this is Ishal's side, the one with the experience. The goblins' camp is two goblin warriors and a goblin shaman spawned beside the player; the popup at the shaman is a popup on his death. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: Ishal's ring and the illusionist's sashes (Sash of Arcane, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Poison, Disease).

quests.name: Act 1: Leonardo
quests.offer: A play! A love story, and you shall choose how it goes. Speak with Leonardo, then take the stage from stage right. Mind the soldiers: they are not acting.

steps.journal: Speak with Leonardo in the tents behind the Theatre.
steps.says: Our hero arrives! To the stage, from stage right.

steps.journal: Walk onto the Theatre's stage from stage right.

events.text: The curtain rises. Five soldiers and their General take the stage!

steps.journal: Kill the five soldiers on the stage.
Kill the General.
Speak with Leonardo, beside the stage.
steps.says: Bravo! Act One is done. Esmeralda has the next.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/the-theatre.json, # The Theatre Quest, Act 1 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One questor at a time in the guide: anyone here. The stage's popup is a reach step. The soldiers and General stand on the stage (two soldiers and the General are spawned too). The guide's 30-minute waits between acts are left out.

quests.name: Act 2: Esmeralda
quests.offer: All you have to do is go with the flow and do what you think is best for the play. Take the stage. The lovers' fear will rise; face it head on.

steps.journal: Take the stage again from stage right.

events.text: Never leave her side, through thick and thin. Face their fears head on. Lover's Fear rises!

steps.journal: Kill Lover's Fear.
Speak with Esmeralda.
steps.says: Beautifully played. Sabrina has the third act.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/the-theatre.json, # The Theatre Quest, Act 2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's quest chat (its choices: never leave her side, the parents, face the fears) is the popup here. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Esmerelda's Belt".

quests.name: Act 3: Sabrina
quests.offer: A plague of slime has fouled our stage. Rid us of it, every drop. It grows as it dies, so be ready.

steps.journal: Take the stage from stage right.

events.text: Something oozes on the far side of the stage.

steps.journal: Kill the clumps of slime.
Kill the mound of slime.
Speak with Sabrina in the tents behind the Theatre.
steps.says: Clean at last! Macaellius has the last act.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/the-theatre.json, # The Theatre Quest, Act 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). quests.name: Act 4: Macaellius
quests.offer: The last act. Acelia is on the stage with four beasts. Save her. When she thanks you, be humble: it is your pleasure, her safety is enough, you are her servant, you want no reward. And let the beasts come.

steps.journal: Take the stage from stage right, where Acelia waits.

events.text: Acelia stands centre stage, four beasts circling her.

steps.journal: Kill the four beasts round Acelia on the stage.
Speak with Acelia, and answer as Macaellius told you.
steps.says: Knowing you are safe is enough? Such a humble hero.
steps.answer: It is my pleasure my lady

steps.journal: Meet Macaellius at his tent.
steps.says: Perfect! Take my script, and see Leonardo.

steps.journal: Speak with Leonardo again.
steps.says: The play is done. Fuzzlemop, by the fire, will want that script.

steps.journal: Trade Macaellius's script to Fuzzlemop, by the fire near Leonardo's tent.
steps.says: The script! A fair trade.

steps.journal: Tell The Storyteller in Baga Village (NE), by the well, the tale.
steps.says: A play, and you the star! A fine tale.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/the-theatre.json, # The Theatre Quest, Act 4 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's five answers to Acelia are her answer and Macaellius's offer here. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the item "Fuzzlemop's necklace" (HoT 10, PoT 10, AR 25).

quests.name: The Dawn Maiden
quests.offer: Nightmares walk in Morningveil and drive folk mad. The Dawn Maiden's pool by the lake shrine is behind it. Take this flask, hug the mountain wall south, and fill it at her pool. Beware: the nightmares hunt the weak.

steps.journal: Hug the mountain wall south of Lieutenant Amin to the big rock.

events.text: A chill. Something follows you out of your own worst dreams!

steps.journal: Kill the nightmare that comes for you.
Kill the Dawn Maiden at her little pool by the lake shrine.
Kill the Dawn Maiden's servant.
Step into the Dawn Maiden's little pond.

events.text: You fill the flask from the pond.

steps.journal: Bring the filled flask to Lieutenant Amin.
steps.says: The nightmares will fade now. Well done.

steps.journal: Tell The Storyteller in Baga Village (NE), by the well, the tale.
steps.says: Nightmares made flesh! A fine tale.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/dawn-maiden.json, # Dawn Maiden Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). quests.name: Totem of the Plains
quests.offer: Rats carry a smudged old totem about, pestilence rats. Bring me one and I will clean it. Old things speak, if you listen.
quests.started: Go, and see what wakes it.

steps.journal: Take a smudged totem of the plains from the pestilence rats.
Bring the smudged totem to Historian Tsali.
steps.says: Clean, it reads: a jumble meaning Snowfist. I will send you up north, to Halas's gate. From there, east.

steps.journal: Enter the large blue-glowing cave in Snowfist (C), east of Halas round the mountains.

events.text: As you step into the cave's blue light, the totem in your pack begins to glow.

steps.journal: Bring the totem back to Historian Tsali.
steps.says: It glows! Take it, and this for your trouble. Pass the totem to someone stronger than you.

quests.name: Totem of the North
quests.offer: You carry a glowing totem of the plains? Let me see it. Old things wake for a reason, and I would know what wakes this one.
quests.started: Go, and see what wakes it.

steps.journal: Show Historian Ilena in Muniel's Tea Garden the glowing totem of the plains.
steps.says: It glows! Something in that Snowfist cave woke it. A totemcarrier there, perhaps. Find out.

steps.journal: Go into the blue-lit cave in Snowfist (C) to its first rooms.
Take a smudged totem of the north from the Snowfist totemcarrier in the blue cave.
Bring the smudged totem to Historian Ilena.
steps.says: The totem of the north. Clean, it points to the mines of TheDruk, out the Fayspires side.

steps.journal: Take the totem of the north to TheDruk mines, out the Fayspires side.

events.text: In the mines, the totem of the north begins to glow.

steps.journal: Bring the totem back to Historian Ilena.
steps.says: It glows! Take it, and this for your trouble. Pass the totem to someone stronger than you.

quests.started: Go, and see what wakes it.

steps.journal: Show Historian Ilena in Muniel's Tea Garden the glowing totem of the north.

steps.journal: Show Historian Ilena in Muniel's Tea Garden the glowing totem of verdance.

Take a smudged totem of the swamp from the gnoll totemkeeper in Blackburrow, by the little tent with a fire.

Take a smudged totem of raining ashes from the spider totemkeeper in the Guk, the first right before the circle bridge.
Bring the smudged totem to Historian Ilena.

events.text: At the castle where the snow dragon is guarded by the tall and the small, the totem glows.

quests.name: The Book of Norrath's Union
quests.offer: The glowing totem of raining ashes. One last mystery: what in Permafrost woke it? Vox's Castle holds the answer. Go and find out.

steps.journal: Show Historian Ilena the glowing totem of raining ashes.
steps.says: In Vox's Castle an ice giant tomekeeper keeps a book. Bring it.

steps.journal: Take the book from the ice giant tomekeeper in Vox's Castle.
Show the book to Historian Ilena.
steps.says: It has no pages! Only one word inside the cover: Home. The pages must be in the homes of the races.

steps.journal: Ask Guard Highmoon, south of Fayspires' main entrance, for the page of verdance.
steps.says: 'Battle an Elf or a halfling and you'll see what I mean.' Here.

steps.journal: Ask Basher Churn, just inside Grobb's entrance, for the page of the swamp.
steps.says: Wez come from da swamp. Take it.

steps.journal: Ask Watchman Ilsey, outside Klick'Anon's south-east gate, for the page of raining ashes.
steps.says: 'Face a Teir'dal or gnome and be reduced to ashes!' Yours.

steps.journal: Ask Guard Therean, near a banker in Highbourne, for the page of the plains.
steps.says: 'Facing a human or Erudite from the plains.' Take it.

steps.journal: Ask Guard Kazah, by Moradhim's blacksmith, for the page of the north.
steps.says: 'To defeat a barbarian or dwarf!' Here.

steps.journal: Have Binder Colessa, in Freeport's Smiling Serpent Inn, bind the pages into the book.
steps.says: Five pages, one book. There.

steps.journal: Bring the bound book to Historian Ilena.
steps.says: Whole again! It tells of Dynmath the Tyrant. Take this, and this totem: it calls him at the portal on Whale Hill, south of Wyndhaven.

quests.name: Dynmath the Tyrant
quests.offer: The totem I gave you calls Dynmath the Tyrant through the portal on Whale Hill. Bind yourself in Wyndhaven: you will die. Speak to the portal, then kill him.

steps.journal: Speak to the portal on Whale Hill, south of Wyndhaven, with the totem.
steps.says: The portal tears open. Dynmath the Tyrant steps through, and the dead with him!

steps.journal: Kill Dynmath the Tyrant.
Return to Historian Ilena.
steps.says: The Tyrant falls! Should you want him again, another totem costs a million tunar.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/dynmath-the-tyrant.json, # Dynmath the Tyrant (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). quests.name: Another Totem of Dynmath
quests.offer: Another totem? It costs a million tunar to make. Then the portal on Whale Hill is yours again.

steps.journal: Pay Historian Ilena 1,000,000 tunar for another totem.
steps.says: Here. Try not to die.

steps.journal: Speak to the portal on Whale Hill with the totem.
steps.says: Dynmath the Tyrant steps through once more!

steps.journal: Kill Dynmath the Tyrant.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/dynmath-the-tyrant.json, # Dynmath the Tyrant, another totem (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide: after killing (or failing to kill) the Tyrant, the historian makes another totem for 1 million tunar.

quests.name: Wards of the Drake Lord: Nature
quests.offer: I was a black necromancer; now I am slave to a drake lord who would overthrow Norrath. His minions carry gems of protection, which five wards will break. Keeper Sari, at Darvar Manor's Black Swan Inn, makes the first.

steps.journal: Find Keeper Sari in the Black Swan Inn at Darvar Manor.
steps.says: Five gems from the emeraldine drakes of Salisearaneen (SW), east of the road by the centaurs' fire. Kill the jade drakes there until they come.

steps.journal: Take five gems from emeraldine drakes in Salisearaneen (SW).
Bring the five emeraldine gems to Keeper Sari.
steps.says: The Ward of Nature. Keeper Ikkl, by the blacksmith in Highpass, makes the next.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/undead-drake-lord.json, # Undead Drake Lord Quest, steps 1-2 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The quest's start is the popup at Magifent's Mausoleum in the guide: Magifent the Unliving gives it here.

quests.name: Wards of the Drake Lord: Desert
quests.offer: Sari sent you? The sandstone drakes in Tak 'Xiz South, east, on the border with Takish'Hiz, carry the gems I need. The torrid drakes there are their kin: kill them until a sandstone comes. Four gems.

steps.journal: Take four gems from sandstone drakes in Tak 'Xiz South (E).
Bring the four sandstone gems to Keeper Ikkl in Highpass.
steps.says: The Ward of Desert. Keeper Rilzen, east of Wyndhaven's coachman, makes the next.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/undead-drake-lord.json, # Undead Drake Lord Quest, step 3 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's torrid drakes are placeholders for the sandstone drakes: the sandstones stand there here.

quests.offer: For the Ward of Frost I need six gems from the pearlescent drakes. They come when the ice drakes round the tower on the hill over the ocean, in Permafrost (W), die.

steps.journal: Go to the tower surrounded by ice drakes on a hill over the ocean, Permafrost (W).
Kill the ice drakes until the pearlescent drakes come, and take six gems.
Bring the six pearlescent gems to Keeper Rilzen in Wyndhaven.
steps.says: The Ward of Frost. Keeper Amani, on the north side of Arcadin's north wall, makes the next.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/undead-drake-lord.json, # Undead Drake Lord Quest, step 4 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Two pearlescent drakes spawn at the tower (one also stands there): the guide's come as ice drakes die.

quests.offer: Fire is the hardest. The rubilent drakes of Lavastorm, on the long path behind the goblin general's fort, carry rubilent gems. Bring me four, I will make them one, and the well behind Blackwater will harden it.

steps.journal: Take four rubilent gems from the rubilent drakes behind the goblin fort in Lavastorm.
Bring the four rubilent gems to Keeper Amani by Arcadin's north wall.
steps.says: One pristine gem. Now harden it in the well behind Blackwater.

steps.journal: Harden the pristine rubilent gem in the well behind Blackwater.

events.text: The gem hisses in the well's water and hardens: the Ward of Fire.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/undead-drake-lord.json, # Undead Drake Lord Quest, step 5 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). quests.name: The Undead Drake Lord
quests.offer: Four wards. The fifth is magic: the bloodstone drakes in the swamp north-east of my tomb guard it. Then I make the Ward of Elements, and you face the drake lord. Bring friends.

steps.journal: Go down to the swamp water a little north-east of Magifent's tomb.

events.text: Bonewings! Bloodstone drakes rise from the swamp.

steps.journal: Kill the bloodstone drakes.
Kill the bloodstone drake gem keeper and take the Ward of Magic.
Bring the five wards to Magifent the Unliving.
steps.says: The Ward of Elements. He waits a little south of my tomb. Go!

steps.journal: Go a little south of Magifent's tomb, where the drake lord rises.
Kill the Undead Drake Lord, and the bloodstones that come with him.
Return to Magifent the Unliving.
steps.says: He is gone! Meet me behind the tomb, to the west, by the rock.

steps.journal: Go behind the tomb, to the west, to the rock.

events.text: A living Magifent steps out, a ghoul at his side. His true form, and none too friendly!

steps.journal: Kill the living Magifent (and his ghoul).
Return to Magifent the Unliving in the tomb.
steps.says: Free of him, and of myself. Take a ring for it.

Bring the shoddy key to Yalie Keylotta outside Highpass's north entrance.
