steps.journal: Wait by the large tree off the road just before Runnyeye's gates (SW).

events.text: A ragged prisoner stumbles out from behind the tree.

steps.journal: Speak with the prisoner by the tree.
steps.says: Free? You have a key? Wait... something is wrong with me... ARGH!

steps.journal: Speak with the goblin prisoner the prisoner became.
steps.says: Hee! Fooled you. Lord Pickclaw wants to meet you, up the sunken canyon north-east.

steps.journal: Find Lord Pickclaw at the dead end of the sunken canyon north-east of the tree, Runnyeye (N).
steps.says: End me? Then come, little one!
steps.answer: I am here to end you.

steps.journal: Kill Lord Pickclaw and take his scepter.
Bring Lord Pickclaw's scepter to Yalie Keylotta.
steps.says: His scepter! The prisoners are safe for now. Choose your reward.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/lord-pickclaw.json, # Lord Pickclaw Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The prisoner's popup is on a 24-hour timer in the guide: a reach step here. Lord Pickclaw, unattackable until talked to in the guide, stands attackable here. The guide's reward is a choice of a head or a waist item for your archetype: the waist one (the guide's pick) for tanks (pickclaw guard's sash), melees (Pickclaw Brawler's Sash) and casters and alchemists (pickclaw arcanist's sash); healers get the Pickclaw Visionsary's Headband (no healers' sash on this server). The pet and illusion rewards are not on this server.

quests.name: Kratas
quests.offer: A sea monster, Kratas, ate my crew. I want revenge, but first he must be lured out. Bring me silk from an ebony recluse in the hills near Kelinar, an ambroise fruit from a calescent ant, and a longfellow bream.

steps.journal: Take silk from the ebony recluse in the hills near Kelinar.
Take an ambroise fruit from a calescent ant in Box Canyon.
Fish a longfellow bream from an ocean watering hole, and bring it all to Julaech.
steps.says: Strange bait, but he loves it. Here, all bundled. Wander near the whale bones by Old Man Antiok, under the water.

steps.journal: Swim to the whale bones under the water near Old Man Antiok.

events.text: Something huge stirs among the bones. Kratas!

steps.journal: Kill Kratas.
Return to Julaech in Mila's Reef.
steps.says: My crew is avenged. Thank you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/kratas.json, # Kratas Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's quest ends at the whale bones: the talk back to Julaech is ours. Kratas's drops (the Harpoon of Telinan for the Plane of Sky, shimmering seaweed, his tentacle) are loot, not a quest reward; he stands among the bones too (FrontiersForge saw him there). The bream is fished (the server's fishing has it).

quests.name: Siliskor
quests.offer: Corliss Magemell, by the river at the far end of Blackwater, went looking for the dragon worshippers. He is not the same since. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then Corliss is on his own.

steps.journal: Find Corliss Magemell by the river at the far end of Blackwater.
steps.says: The dragon worshippers' cave, south-west past the troll camp in the swamps. Find out what they worship.

steps.journal: Go into the Dragon Cultists' cave, down the second ramp to the dragon altar.

events.text: At the dragon altar a voice fills your head. You are being watched.

steps.journal: Rush out of the cave by its main entrance.

events.text: Outside, a great dragon eyes you from afar, then vanishes.

steps.journal: Return to Corliss Magemell in Blackwater.
steps.says: Siliskor has cursed me! In the cave, a Mirrored Soul holds the Scepter of Reflection. Bring it.

steps.journal: Go back to the Dragon Cultists' cave.
Kill the Mirrored Soul and take the Scepter of Reflection.
Bring the scepter to Corliss Magemell.
steps.says: The curse lifts! Siliskor waits in the Elephant Graveyard, by the crooked elephant statue. Gather your guild.

steps.journal: Approach the crooked elephant statue in the west of the Elephant Graveyard.

events.text: The ground shakes. Siliskor rises, with Pomus Magemell and two dragon worshippers!

steps.journal: Kill Siliskor.
Tell Corliss Magemell Siliskor is dead.
steps.says: Then I am truly free. Thank you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/siliskor.json, # Siliskor Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's trigger system (one questor at a time, the flag lost on a crash) is left out. Siliskor stands by the elephant statue (the server's attackable Siliskor) and his followers spawn with the popup. His drop, the Shield of King Jorat for the Plane of Sky, is loot, not a quest reward; the closing talk is ours.

quests.name: Snowgrin
quests.offer: Behind the tapestry in the throne room something big waits to be let out. Three keys open the way, carried by Relk Icemapper, General Frostbeard and Warlord Kraven. They spawn once a day or so. Bring me all three.
quests.declined: Then he stays behind the tapestry.

steps.journal: Take Relk Icemapper's key: right from this room, right at the hall, second right, down the stairs.
Take General Frostbeard's key: left, straight down the long hall to the room split by a wall, by the bed.
Find Warlord Kraven by the big ramp, a level down past the two ice giants.
Take Warlord Kraven's key.
Bring the three keys to Karis McDonogh in the long hallway on the second level.
steps.says: All three! Go to the throne room, behind the tapestry. Mind his first breath: it is cold.

steps.journal: Go behind the tapestry in the throne room of Vox's Castle.

events.text: Grilmesh Frostcackle cackles a rhyme, and the snow piles up into a twenty-foot snowman!

steps.journal: Kill Snowgrin.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/snowgrin.json, # Snowgrin Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Karis McDonough and Grilmash Frostcackle are the game's Karis McDonogh and Grilmesh Frostcackle. Snowgrin's rares (Dragoneye, Crystalline Spear, Storm's Edge ...) are loot, not a quest reward; the quest gives none. Warlord Kraven stands as a townsperson in the database (npc_type 0x80): the step's start spawns a hostile copy, but check_quests.py wants an attackable row of the name, so it is listed as unresolved until one exists (a seed's ATTACKABLE entry) or the checker accepts a hostile spawn.

quests.name: Terrorantula
quests.offer: The Terrorantula has haunted these sands too long. Five parchments tell its history, scattered across Tak Xiv and Takish'Hiz. Bring me all five and I will learn how to rid Tunaria of it. Bind near Oasis.

steps.journal: Approach the glowing rocks on a small dune south of the river, Tak Xiv West (W).

events.text: A parchment flutters in the rocks, and a Death Weaver rises to guard it!

steps.journal: Kill the Death Weaver for the first parchment.
Find the lone rock on a small hill south in the east of the next zone west.

events.text: Another parchment, and a Death Spitter!

steps.journal: Kill the Death Spitter for the second parchment.
Search the sand by the tower of Truearrow scouts in Takish'Hiz (SE).

events.text: A parchment blows across the sand into your hand.

steps.journal: Zig-zag through the joined columns south of the dam in Tak Xiz South (C).

events.text: Wedged between two columns: a parchment.

steps.journal: Zig-zag through the columns north of the dam.

events.text: The last parchment, half buried in sand.

steps.journal: Bring the five parchments to Yulil Ashebrooke.
steps.says: All five! Now I understand... no! It comes! RUN!

steps.journal: Kill the Terrorantula and its poisonweavers.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/terrorantula.json, # Terrorantula Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Yulil vanishing while one person holds the quest is left out. The parchments' popups are reach steps (the third, fourth and fifth give their parchment). The places are FrontiersForge's sightings and ours (Tak Xiz South's columns by the dam). There is no experience; the Terrorantula's drops (terrorbrood sandals, spider fur gloves, its hide, the dull rings, the staff and robe of the terrorbrood) are loot.

quests.name: Envar Island: Lord Valkanith
quests.offer: Long ago the elven empire of the Tal'Thex fell, and its dead do not rest. Bring me its three gems, an emerald, a ruby and a diamond, and I will tell you how to end it. Be ready when you bring them.
quests.declined: Then the dead keep their vigil.
quests.started: Takish'Hiz, Geomancer's Citadel, Sycamore Joy's Rest.

steps.journal: Take the Tal'Thex emerald from the creatures inside the city of Takish'Hiz.
Take the Tal'Thex ruby from the rallosian spectres of Geomancer's Citadel.
Take the Tal'Thex diamond from the dark elves of Sycamore Joy's Rest, on the east coast.
Bring the three gems to the Spirit of Tellainain on Envar's island.
steps.says: The gems! They wake! The Tal'thex come!

steps.journal: Fight off the Tal'thex undead: kill their sorcerers.
Kill Lord Valkanith, who comes as the last sorcerer dies.

events.text: Lord Valkanith... comes...

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/lord-valkanith.json, # Lord Valkanith Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The gems drop off the creatures the guide names: the city of Takish'Hiz's (its star knights here), Geomancer's Citadel's rallosian spectres and warlords (the spectral rallosians), Sycamore Joy's Rest's dark elves (its Teir'dal knights). The guide's half-hour of undead before Lord Valkanith is three sorcerers here. His 30-minute despawn and the advice to delete the quest before he dies are left out; his Bone Wing Sentinel rune is loot.

quests.name: Jaeger Mansion
quests.offer: The statue's stone eyes follow you. An hourglass-shaped hollow is cut into its base. Something that fits it would open the crypt below.
quests.started: The hollow waits for its hourglass.

steps.journal: Kill Kaila Jaeger by the lake east of the tower and take the ruby hourglass key.
Kill Sept Elder Sesh on the mansion's third floor (by Garou Red Claws's room) and take the ruby hourglass.
Set the ruby hourglass in the Jaeger Statue by the graveyard.
steps.says: The statue's eyes burn red. It moves!

steps.journal: Destroy the Jaeger Mansion Statue.
Enter the crypt and, to the left, kill the Paladin Lord and his spectres.
Turn right in the crypt, follow the corridor to the coffin, and kill Magnus Jaeger, father of all vampires.
Give the sapphire hourglass to the Jaeger Statue to leave the crypt.
steps.says: The crypt seals behind you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/jaeger-mansion.json, # Jaeger Mansion Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's giver is the statue itself. Its two passes through the crypt (a Paladin Lord or a named wizard the first time, the ruby hourglass then taken off Sept Elder Sesh's corpse left outside, then Magnus Jaeger) are one here: the hourglass key and the hourglass, then the hostile statue (a copy), the Paladin Lord and Magnus Jaeger, who stand in the crypt. The named wizard's path is left out. The crypt's drops (Halberd of Faith, Earring of Might, Scepter of Fury, Black Ruby Earring, Moonfang, Boots of Regalia) are loot.

quests.name: Radavex's Teleportation Orb
quests.offer: The orb hums: find the ward stone of the sword and the ward stone of the stars and bring them back to the teleportation orb to activate Radavex's teleportation orb.

steps.journal: Kill Captain Ealesha, who walks from the tent to the ramp outside the tower, for the ward stone of the sword.
Kill Apprentice Yavim, behind the altar in the tower, for the ward stone of the stars.
Bring both ward stones back to the teleportation orb.
steps.says: The orb flares. A crystal forms: Radavex's Orb.

steps.journal: Use Radavex's Orb atop the tower and kill Radavex.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/radavex.json, # Radavex Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's semi-rare spawns (the orb, Ealesha and Yavim) stand here. Radavex's orb (a two-second group port to the top of the tower) is a crystal the orb gives, and Radavex is spawned beside the player. His and his guards' Planeswalker faction (-10 a kill) is the kill's faction here (one -10 at the kill step). The reward is his loot (Radavex's bracers, the nullfield earring, the starbladed staff). Apprentice Yavim and Radavex Planeswalker stands as a townsperson in the database (npc_type 0x80): the step's start spawns a hostile copy, but check_quests.py wants an attackable row of the name, so it is listed as unresolved until one exists (a seed's ATTACKABLE entry) or the checker accepts a hostile spawn.

quests.name: The Staff of Rainbow Magic: The Blue Gem
quests.offer: Bristlebane's Staff of Rainbow Magic lies shattered, its gems scattered. Help me make it whole. Gil Swimmerbee, in a boat by a dock in Vastly Deep (W), lost the blue gem. Start with him.

steps.journal: Find Gil Swimmerbee in a boat by a dock in Vastly Deep (W).
steps.says: My gem is at the bottom of the sea. I need a breathing device: Steely Stoutdale, by Anu Village's west wall, makes them.

steps.journal: Find Steely Stoutdale outside the west wall of Anu Village.
steps.says: A breathing device? Bring me the mask of the sly ice giant, north-west over the dark ice.

steps.journal: Kill the sly ice giant in the valley north-west of Steely and take his mask.

items.item: Mask of the Sly Ice Giant

steps.journal: Bring the mask to Steely Stoutdale.

items.item: Mask of the Sly Ice Giant

steps.says: Here, a breath potion. Take 3000 tunar for Ks'or, the merman below.

steps.journal: Swim to the underwater ruins at the bottom of Vastly Deep and pay Ks'or 3000 tunar.
steps.says: The blue gem, for your coin. Mind the mermaids.

steps.journal: Have Gemmaster Thoren, west of Moradhim's coach by a tree, polish it for 1500 tunar.
steps.says: There, it shines.

steps.journal: Bring the polished blue gem to the Acolyte of Bristlebane by Bobble-by-Water's coach.
steps.says: The blue gem! One of five.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/acolyte-of-bristlebane.json, # [Blue Gem] (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide calls it a Fan Faire quest; it plays as an ordinary one here. Steely and Gil's back-and-forth after Ks'or is cut (the guide: you may go straight to Thoren). The breath potion is a quest item; this server's breathing is its own.

quests.name: The Staff of Rainbow Magic: The Green Gem
quests.offer: The green gem. Mixoxullous, just south-east of Murnf's coach, knows of it. Hear him out.

steps.journal: Find Mixoxullous just south-east of Murnf's coach.
steps.says: Creepyman holds Baylor, who had the green gem. South-west of 'The Golden Road' signpost in Salisearaneen (W). Kill him.

steps.journal: Kill Creepyman, south-west of the Golden Road signpost in Salisearaneen (W).
Speak with Baylor, freed.
steps.says: I gave the gem to Oppydna, east of here, at the foot of a hill.

steps.journal: Buy the green gem from Oppydna in Salisearaneen (C) for 3500 tunar.
steps.says: It is yours.

steps.journal: Bring the green gem to the Acolyte of Bristlebane.
steps.says: Two of five!

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/acolyte-of-bristlebane.json, # [Green Gem] (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide calls it a Fan Faire quest; it plays as an ordinary one here.

quests.name: The Staff of Rainbow Magic: The Red Gem
quests.offer: The red gem lies in the fire of Mount Hatespike. Leeanna, on the shore just north of Wyndhaven, has something that will let you touch it.

steps.journal: Find Leeanna on the shore just north of Wyndhaven.
steps.says: Wear these Gloves of No Ouchies. By the Bloodfoot camp's blacksmith on Mount Hatespike, a ledge faces the lava.

steps.journal: Find the ledge facing the lava by the blacksmith at the Bloodfoot camp, Mount Hatespike.

events.text: Your gloves close on a scorched red gem in the heat.

steps.journal: Show the scorched red gem to Leeanna.
steps.says: Scorched! High Druid Postmanjim, outside Qeynos's south wall, can help.

steps.journal: Find High Druid Postmanjim outside Qeynos's south wall.
steps.says: High Shaman Bradue, at the west wall's corner, knows the cleaning.

steps.journal: Find High Shaman Bradue at the corner of Qeynos's west wall.
steps.says: Bring me an icy vial from the tenacious frost giants.

steps.journal: Take an icy vial from a tenacious frost giant.
Bring the icy vial to High Shaman Bradue.
steps.says: Now a polishing cloth: High Sorcerer Coolade sells them in Kelinar.

steps.journal: Buy a polishing cloth from High Sorcerer Coolade in Kelinar, 12,000 tunar.
steps.says: Two thousand... and ten more. A fine cloth.

steps.journal: Bring the gem and the cloth to High Druid Postmanjim.
steps.says: Clean as new. Take it back to Leeanna.

steps.journal: Return to Leeanna.
steps.says: Beautiful! Take it to the acolyte.

steps.journal: Bring the red gem to the Acolyte of Bristlebane.
steps.says: Three of five!

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/acolyte-of-bristlebane.json, # [Red Gem] (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide calls it a Fan Faire quest; it plays as an ordinary one here. The ledge's popup is a reach step at EQOA-Data's map point.

quests.name: The Staff of Rainbow Magic: The Yellow Gem
quests.offer: The yellow gem's last owners were Sunshine and Beam Brightray, in the south of Merry-by-Water. Ask them.

steps.journal: Find Sunshine and Beam Brightray in the south of Merry-by-Water.
steps.says: We split its power among our four children, and a necromancer's star-magic took them: four starfish on far shores.

steps.journal: Find the starfish on the shore of Erud's Crossing (SW).

events.text: A starfish glows at your touch: the gem's power, set free.

steps.journal: Find the starfish on the shore of Kerra Isle (C/S).

events.text: A starfish glows at your touch: the gem's power, set free.

steps.journal: Find the starfish on the shore of Kerra Isle (W/S).

events.text: A starfish glows at your touch: the gem's power, set free.

steps.journal: Find the starfish on the shore of West Toxxulia (E/SE).

events.text: A starfish glows at your touch: the gem's power, set free.

steps.journal: Return to Beam Brightray in Merry-by-Water.
steps.says: Our children are home! The gem is whole.

steps.journal: Bring the yellow gem to the Acolyte of Bristlebane.
steps.says: Four of five!

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/acolyte-of-bristlebane.json, # [Yellow Gem] (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide calls it a Fan Faire quest; it plays as an ordinary one here. The starfish's places are EQOA-Data's map points (Odus, by a fit of its points).

quests.name: The Staff of Rainbow Magic: The Gem of Nykitas
quests.offer: The last gem, the Gem of Nykitas. Blacksmith Kadeshi knows where it is, but the fire goblins hold him in Lavastorm, near their fort. Free him.

steps.journal: Kill the fire goblins near their fort in Lavastorm (NW) for an oddly shaped key.
Free Blacksmith Kadeshi with the key.
steps.says: Free! The Gem of Nykitas is with Xalakharx, at the first spectral rallosian cave in Geomancer's Pass (W).

steps.journal: Pay Xalakharx in Geomancer's Pass 10,000 tunar.
steps.says: A spectral warlord carries the gem. Kill them until the named one comes.

steps.journal: Kill the spectral warlords for the Gem of Nykitas.
Bring the Gem of Nykitas to Xalakharx.
steps.says: Now I set the gems. The Staff of Rainbow Magic, all but its handle.

steps.journal: Show the staff to the Acolyte of Bristlebane.
steps.says: Five of five! Only the handle now.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/acolyte-of-bristlebane.json, # [Gem of Nykitas] (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide calls it a Fan Faire quest; it plays as an ordinary one here. The fire goblins' key drops off their champions here; the named warlord (unnamed in the guide) is any spectral warlord at a quarter's chance.

quests.name: The Staff of Rainbow Magic: The Handle
quests.offer: The handle lies on an island of necro birds in Lake Rathe, to the east. Its guardian will not give it up easily.

steps.journal: Climb to the top of the island with necro birds in Lake Rathe (E).

events.text: The Rainbow Magic Guardian rears up, a dragon of every colour!

steps.journal: Kill the Rainbow Magic Guardian and take the hand grip.
Speak with the Tree of Life that grows on the island.
steps.says: Bristlebane's staff, whole. He laughs, somewhere. Take this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/acolyte-of-bristlebane.json, # [Handle] (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide calls it a Fan Faire quest; it plays as an ordinary one here. The class item is given where this server has the guide's: the magician's Slippers of the Trickster, the warrior's Boots of Mischief, the ranger's Mischievous Boots (a level 60 item here). Not on this server, left out: the other classes' (Mischievous Pants, Leggings of the Trickster, Pants of the Trickster, Leggings of Trickery, Gloves of Mischief, Trickster's Gloves, Boots of Trickery, Gloves of Trickery; the bard's, druid's, monk's and shaman's are unnamed).

quests.name: Harbingers of Khalimet
quests.offer: The demon general Khalimet is coming, and four harbingers go before him. One has been seen. Gaulin, on the docks of the pond in the hidden village through the tunnel at the Shon-To Monastery, knows more.

steps.journal: Find Gaulin on the pond's docks in the hidden village at the Shon-To Monastery.
steps.says: A demon attacked my camp in Box Canyon. Find my abandoned camp and see what it left.

steps.journal: Approach Gaulin's abandoned camp on the left of the canyon in Box Canyon (C).

events.text: Ash and broken tents. Armis rises from the ruin, a fire pet at his side!

steps.journal: Kill Armis and take the Tome of Khalimet.
Take the Wand of Shattered Souls from Armis.
Bring the wand to Anibael in Muniel's Tea Garden (SE).
steps.says: Keep the tome. Salin, on the third floor of Highbourne's library, can read it.

steps.journal: Show the tome to Salin in Highbourne's library.
steps.says: It is beyond me. Torgias Bullow, west on the road from Murnf's coach, may decipher it.

steps.journal: Fight off the Assassin of Khal who comes for the tome.
Give the tome to Torgias Bullow in a little house west of Murnf's coach.
steps.says: I will read it. But I am hungry: fruit from Farmer Phenray in Freeport's bazaar, if you would.

steps.journal: Buy fruit from Farmer Phenray by Grocer Gloresa in Freeport's bazaar, 10,000 tunar.
steps.says: My best.

steps.journal: Bring the fruit to Torgias Bullow.
steps.says: Four scrolls, one for each harbinger. Write each word backwards, and the vowels aeiou become eioua.

steps.journal: 'With the fiery of fire he comes, but in a land that is frosty': kill Lord Farex by the portal in Permafrost (E).
'In a land of watery muck and skulls': kill Lord Wraymot at the portal in Broken Skull Rock (NW).
'Through an arid region he brings his hate': kill Lord Tallivar at the portal in Desert Hate (S).
'Born to a mountain of hate he comes': kill Lord Vengal at the portal on Mount Hatespike.
Show the four Khal gems to Anibael in Muniel's Tea Garden.
steps.says: All four harbingers dead! Keep the gems: when Khalimet comes, you will need them.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/harbingers-of-khalimet.json, # Harbingers of Khalimet, Part I (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The scrolls' riddles (written backwards, the vowels shifted) are in the journal lines, decoded. The Assassins of Khal, who may attack at any time, are one spawned at Salin's. The guide's gem bag from Salin and its luck-stone reward (a 5-charge 'lucky stone': not on this server) are left out; the gems are kept, as the guide says. The harbingers' places are ours, from the zones the guide names. Part II (Khalimet's portal, the hounds, the waves and the Khal Viceroy) and Part IV (the Warrior, the city portals, the Desmosdus breeders of ZP, the Chiktar King) are not written.

quests.name: The Testament of Khal
quests.offer: Khal's zealots in the camps of Permafrost (S) carry a testament of his. Bring me one: there may be something in it worth knowing.

steps.journal: Take the Testament of Khal from a Khal zealot in the camps of Permafrost (S).
Show the testament to Anibael.
steps.says: Chimaerian! Salin must see it.

steps.journal: Show the testament to Salin in Highbourne's library.
steps.says: The Tome of Khalimet: only his most ardent carry it. Seek one who lives north of the glades.

steps.journal: Give the testament to Torgias Bullow, west of Murnf's coach.
steps.says: Written in lycan. Khalimet began the lycan bloodline... the plane of war is about to spill into Tunaria.

steps.journal: Fight off the Khal reavers waiting outside Torgias's house.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/harbingers-of-khalimet.json, # Harbingers of Khalimet, Part III (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide calls this part a lore tie-in: no reward. The Khal spies' notes and the warlords' drops (robes, class weapons) are loot.

quests.name: Gnadriin
quests.offer: Anibael, it's me. Khalimet needs one last thing for his foothold: a scroll, far east of Oasis. Its keeper is powerful, and Salin must not know. Bring me that scroll.

steps.journal: Find The Keeper on an island south of the mage spell merchant in Elemental Towers (C).
steps.says: You come for the scroll? Then take it from me!

steps.journal: Kill The Keeper and take the scroll.
Take the scroll to Salin, in the south wing of Highbourne's library.
steps.says: The bolash breed desmodus bats to spread their curse. Khalimet fights them, and Anibael is a Gnadriin!

steps.journal: Confront Anibael with her betrayal.
steps.says: So Salin talks too much. Then die!

steps.journal: Kill Anibael.
Tell Salin you killed Anibael.
steps.says: The Gnadriin take the shapes of those whose blood they drink. There are more: by a campfire in Muniel's Tea Garden. Kill them.

steps.journal: Speak to the weary adventurer by the campfire in Muniel's Tea Garden (C).
steps.says: Leave us be! ... Too late. You know.

steps.journal: Kill the weary adventurers and the Gnadriin they become, for a warsword.
Show the warsword to Salin.
steps.says: Khalimet's gems can make weapons stronger. Hogarth Bartholomew, south-east of Moradhim, knows how.

steps.journal: Find Hogarth Bartholomew on a hill south-east of Moradhim's coach.
steps.says: First, help me: Galoosh, Tobral Arnez and Jon Watersmith owe me. Recover my payments.

steps.journal: Find Galoosh north of the little outpost outside Grobb.
steps.says: Here, here. Hogarth's payment.

steps.journal: Fight Tobral Arnez in the broken tower east of Neriak's ramp for Hogarth's staff.
Find Jon Watersmith's camp at the edge of the plains and mountains, Mossmouth (E).
steps.says: I have nothing! Arliss has it. Ask Jingle in Oasis.

steps.journal: Find Jingle in Oasis, north of the coach by the banner.
steps.says: Arliss? West of Gramash Ruins, in a camp off the road north from Murnf.

steps.journal: Kill Arliss in the camp off the road north from Murnf and take Hogarth's sword.
Bring the payment, the staff and the sword to Hogarth Bartholomew.
steps.says: All three! Khalimet's gems fit the warlords' weapons. For 10,000 tunar I will set one, for 2000 take it out.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/harbingers-of-khalimet.json, # Harbingers of Khalimet, Part V (Gnadriin) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Part V follows Part IV in the guide; Part IV is not written, so it follows Part I here. Hogarth's augmentation (a gem set into a warlord's weapon for 10,000 tunar) is not something the engine does: the quest ends with him. Anibael's Gnadriin Blade, a drop the guide says is not needed, is left out. The weary adventurers' four (a dark elf, a dwarf, a barbarian and a human) are one spawned with a Gnadriin. The places are ours, from the guide's zones.

quests.name: Unkempt War
quests.offer: The Dawn and Moon tribes will make war on the defenders of these woods. Before I trust you with that, bring me four faerie dusts: any faerie carries it, the wood faeries most of all.
quests.accept: I will help defend the woods.

steps.journal: Take four faerie dusts from the faeries of the Unkempt woods.
Bring the four faerie dusts to Elaryness in the tree-house village.
steps.says: Now go to my father's grave: south out of the village, west at the fork, the island with the weeping willow.

steps.journal: Find the Unkempt grave on the island with a weeping willow, Unkempt Glade (N/C).

events.text: You kneel at the grave. The willow's leaves stir though there is no wind.

steps.journal: Return to Elaryness.
steps.says: He rests. Now: Dresden Windstalker, on the flattened hill south-east of here. Gather your forces first.

steps.journal: Speak with Dresden Windstalker on the flattened hill south-east of Elaryness, when your forces are in place.
steps.says: Then it begins. The tribes come!

steps.journal: Hold the Dawn tribe's camps: kill their tribesmen.
Kill the Ward of Dawn Minor.
Kill the Ward of Dawn Major.
Kill the Dawn tribe's leader, Supreme Ward Boreg.
Hold the Moon tribe's camps: kill their tribesmen.
Kill Night Reaper Omega.
Kill Night Reaper Beta.
Kill the Moon tribe's leader, Alpha Reaper Hanz.
Return to Dresden Windstalker.
steps.says: The war is won! Go to Elaryness for your reward.

steps.journal: Return to Elaryness.
steps.says: The woods are safe because of you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/unkempt-war.json, # Unkempt War Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's faction rule is fuzzy (logged at -335, 'not 0 as others say', when Elaryness is white-faced): -350 with the Unkempt Defenders here. The war (four to six camps, an hour, the bosses by chance as the majors and betas die, a guild's worth of players, an area flag for all) is the tribes' named leaders in order here, standing where the server has them; there is no time limit. The grave's place is ours. Not on this server, left out of the rewards: the class weapons (Sash of Wild Elements, Star of Ehayae, Horn of Nellynussia, Iujien Bone Wand, Wyldwood Longbow, Saptapper, Rootpiercer, Lumbersbane, Fire of Ehayae). The bosses' drops are loot.

quests.name: Avatar of Fear
quests.offer: The altar is carved with a pyramid and a screaming face. A hollow at its heart is stained dark, as if something living was once laid there: an archon's heart, it seems.
quests.declined: The face on the altar seems to laugh.
quests.started: The archons are in the tunneler's tunnel.

steps.journal: Kill the Tae Ew archon in the tunnel where the Tae Ew tunneler spawns (back right, facing the altar).
Lay the archon heart in the altar of the centre room.
steps.says: The heart sinks into the stone, and a ruby talisman rises.

steps.journal: Kill High Priest Siblis, a level up, for a symbol of fear.
Kill High Priest Siblis again until he leaves his skull.
Step into the pool in the chamber of the Thulian maneaters.

events.text: You toss the Skull of Siblis into the pool. The water boils: the Hand of Thule!

steps.journal: Kill the Hand of Thule and take the top half of the tablet.
Step into the pool again with your symbol of fear.

events.text: You toss the symbol of fear into the pool, and a sapphire talisman floats up.

steps.journal: Use the golem's portal (down the back left hall) to the next temple, and search the tunnel's dead end.

events.text: You search, and search again: at last, the bottom half of the tablet!

steps.journal: Drop through the green water into the inner pyramid and kill a Tae Ew chosen for the emerald talisman.
Keep killing the Tae Ew chosen until the Horn of Cazic drops.
Place the three talismans, the horn and the two halves on the altar beside the spirit guardian.
steps.says: The tablet glows and fuses: the Tablet of Haz'Kar.

steps.journal: Clear the room, buff up, and give the altar the Tablet of Haz'Kar.
steps.says: Across the room, the Avatar of Fear takes shape!

steps.journal: Kill the Avatar of Fear.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Misc/avatar-of-fear.json, # Avatar of Fear (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide has no quest NPC: the altar in the centre room gives it here (an object of ours, the map's 'altar in center room'), and the altar beside the spirit guardian is another. Each party member's own symbol and talisman, the transport orb and the golem's port are left out (the golem is a reach step at the next temple's dead end, where the search's spider is left out too). The guide names no reward.
